ترتكسوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِسُوا (tartakisū) /tar.ta.ki.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# تُرْتَكَسُوا (turtakasū) /tur.ta.ka.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
